annotations.text:
Clickable prototype — the nav pills switch screens, the range chips redraw the hero chart and
everything derived from it, hovering the chart gives a crosshair tooltip, queue rows and filters
are selectable, the review actions change state, and stage rows swap the trace payload below.

Structure and vocabulary come from the running system: intents, the eight gates, reason codes and
the weighted-score signals are the ones in domain/enums.py and config/thresholds.yaml. The rows
themselves are sample data — but internally consistent: reason codes sum to the messages the same
screen says went to review, and gate vetoes are the escalations carrying each gate's code.
